choice_prompt:2:1521368001.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>大人，加拉……！真没想到你们会再来看我。
choice_prompt:2:1521368001.male: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Gala, what a surprise. I didn't think you'd come visit me again.
choice_prompt:2:1521368001.female: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Gala, what a surprise. I didn't think you'd come visit me again.

say:4:1521368004:0.text: I've thought about that letter Marco wrote... and I don't think he meant a word of it.
say:4:1521368004:0.source_cn: 而且我现在也想通了。马尔科写的那封信……恐怕也不是他的...

say:5:1521368005:0.text: I'd rather believe what we had at Mirehold was real. And even if it wasn't... that's okay.
say:5:1521368005:0.source_cn: 我愿意相信我和他在水泽营地经历的一切都不是假的……就算...

say:6:1521368006:0.text: It was beautiful, and it was real to me. That's enough.
say:6:1521368006:0.source_cn: 我只要记得那很美好，就足够了。

say:7:1521368007:0.text: He chose to let go, and I'm choosing to respect that.
say:7:1521368007:0.source_cn: 既然他做出了切断这段感情的决定……那我就尊重他。

say:8:1521368008:0.text: Besides, if he didn't even have the courage to try, then he's not someone worth waiting for!
say:8:1521368008:0.source_cn: 更何况，他连试都没勇气试，这样的人才不值得我挂念！

choice_prompt:9:1521368008.text: Besides, if he didn't even have the courage to try, then he's not someone worth waiting for!
choice_prompt:9:1521368008.source_cn: 更何况，他连试都没勇气试，这样的人才不值得我挂念！

say:10:1521368010:0.text: Right now, I just want to live well.
say:10:1521368010:0.source_cn: 现在，我只想过好以后的生活。

choice:9:0:1.text: I'm glad you see that now.
choice:9:0:1.male: I'm glad you see that now.
choice:9:0:1.female: I'm glad you see that now.

say:13:1521368009:0.text: Maybe. But that's not my problem anymore.

choice:9:2:3.text: Marco is going to regret this.
choice:9:2:3.source_cn: 我觉得马尔科会后悔的
choice:9:2:3.male: Marco is going to regret this.
choice:9:2:3.female: Marco is going to regret this.

say:2:1521356001:0.source_cn: 马尔科……我们终于可以在一起了！

say:3:1521356002:0.text: You did it... I knew you would...
say:3:1521356002:0.source_cn: 你做到了……我就知道你一定可以的……

say:4:1521356003:0.text: Thank you for believing in me...

say:5:1521356004:0.text: Honestly, I was terrified. I kept thinking... if I died, would it break your heart?
say:5:1521356004:0.source_cn: 我刚刚真的很害怕……害怕如果我真的死了，你也会难过……

say:6:1521356005:0.text: That wouldn't happen. Father is not a killer.
say:6:1521356005:0.source_cn: 不会，阿爹才不会那么狠心。

say:7:1521356006:0.text: Come on, let me take you back to Mirehold so you can rest. When you're better, we'll find somewhere quiet, just for us.
say:7:1521356006:0.source_cn: 我带你回水泽营地养伤吧。等到你养好了，我们找一个没人打...

say:8:1521356007:0.text: Yeah... no one's going to stand in our way again.
say:8:1521356007:0.source_cn: 好……不会再有任何人阻拦我们了。

narration:15:15020256:0.text: With Sharpjaw's blessing, Marco and Fufu are together at last.
narration:15:15020256:0.source_cn: 马尔科获得了颚的认可，和芙终成眷属。

cinematic_dialogue:1:1521351001:.text: Marco! I missed you so much!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1521351002:.text: Me too. It's been so long...
cinematic_dialogue:1:1521351002:.source_cn: 我也是，终于又见到你了……

cinematic_dialogue:1:1521351004:.text: Get your hands off my sister!
